body: apps/desktop Phase 3 IPC/security patterns: dropped-folder absolute path obtained via webUtils.getPathForFile(File) exposed through preload (the supported way under contextIsolation+no nodeIntegration; File can't cross contextBridge otherwise). file:read IPC guards path traversal (resolved abs must startWith project root). Project id is deterministic sha1(rootPath) so re-adding a folder updates, never duplicates. chokidar watcher per project root, debounced 200ms, batches paths, sends 'project:files-changed' to renderer which re-reads only if a changed path endsWith the active file's relPath. fs walk blacklists noise dirs by name (node_modules/.git/dist/build/out/.turbo/.pnpm/.cache/coverage) NOT all dot-dirs. Renderer registry currently md/mdx/markdown only; json/csv/schema deferred to Phase 4.
